arch.split.title: Backend ↔ Frontend in 30 seconds
arch.split.back: Python 3.11+ · FastAPI under /api/v1/ · Pydantic v2 · SQLAlchemy 2 + SQLite + Alembic · parsers .docx, .doc, .pdf, .xlsx/.xlsm, .xml/S1000D (text fallback) · 7 sequential checks driven by a configurable rule catalog + importable custom rules (Excel checklist) · Mistral API (chat + RAG embeddings + optional multimodal vision) · httpx async + SSE · structlog.
arch.split.front: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + TanStack Query + i18next (FR/EN), built into frontend/dist/ and served by the backend · Manager · Projects · Editor · Chatbot · Architecture · Data · Settings tabs.
arch.f2: Upload the expected reference (.xlsx/.xlsm) + the documents (.docx, .doc, .pdf, .xlsx, .xml/S1000D). Automatic SHA-256 versioning.
arch.f3: "Run analysis" → 7 sequential checks applied to the latest version of each file; anomalies are created with status open.
arch.f4: If Mistral is configured: RAG indexing (chunking + embeddings) stored in SQLite, to enable the chatbot.
arch.f5: Manager view: project KPIs. Editor view: anomalies grouped by file with suggestions. Chatbot: RAG Q&A with [file_name] citations.
arch.f6: Anomaly lifecycle: open → acknowledged → fixed (resolved) or rejected (false positive). CSV export anytime.

settings.apiKeyPh: leave empty to keep the current key

settings.refColumnPlaceholder: Tip: in a rule instruction, write {column_name} to inject the values of a project reference column (defined in the project detail, Reference card).
referentiel.baslTitle: BASL — spare parts, tooling, infrastructure, header
referentiel.baslMappingHint: BASL columns: pick the sheet then the column for each field (spare part / tooling / infrastructure). A column left empty makes the check run against every cell of the BASL.
referentiel.mappingHint: Reference columns: pick the sheet then the column. Added columns can be called via {name} in custom rules.
referentiel.builtinHint: Built-in column (script / element) — name not editable.
referentiel.headerRowHint: Header row of each sheet: click the row holding the column names to align the labels in the « Column » menus.
settings.rulesInfo: Editable here. Changes are stored in data/rules.json. "Reset" reverts to the code defaults in app/core/rules.py.
settings.rulesV4Banner: The v4 engine applies 16 rule families defined in app/core/rules.py. Adjustable parameters below are stored in data/rules.json; "Reset" reverts to the code defaults.
settings.rulesReadOnlyBanner: Default business rule catalog, defined in code and listed here read-only for transparency. To add your own checks, use the custom rules (editable) and checklist import above.
settings.exportRulesMdHint: Downloads a RULES.md document that reflects the engine's current state (sections, parameters, examples).
settings.customRulesIntro: Rules evaluated by the embedded Mistral on each document analyzed. Describe the rule in plain language in "Instruction". Active only when Mistral is configured. Emits "personnalisee" anomalies.
settings.importHint: Import an Excel checklist (.xlsx/.xlsm): each row becomes an AI-evaluated custom rule. "topic" column → label, "check" column → instruction.
settings.importReplaceWarn: "Replace" mode deletes all current custom rules before importing.
settings.importClickHeader: Click the header row, then pick the columns.
settings.pendingHint: Imported rules wait for human validation before taking part in analysis.
settings.extractFromSpec: Extract rules from a spec document (AI)
settings.illusFormatHint: Figure marker format: every marker must follow the form RepXX(FigZZ) (e.g. Rep1(Fig2)). Malformed variants are reported as illustration anomalies.
settings.illusCoherenceLabel: Check that every marker called in the text is visible on the illustrations (and vice versa) — requires configured Mistral vision.
settings.illusVisionQuestions: Visual compliance questions (Mistral vision) — one per line
rules.ambiguous: Ambiguous pairs (term1, term2 — one per line)
rules.logicalPairsHint: If the action appears in the document, its expected counter-action must also appear. Mistral filters out plausible omissions (documents without an expected counter-action, etc.).
data.resetHint: All these operations are irreversible. Mistral settings and business rules are preserved.
anomaly.illustration.repFormat.suggestio: All markers must follow the form RepXX(FigZZ).
anomaly.illustration.widthOutOfRange.mes: Illustration #{idx}: width {width} px out of range.
anomaly.illustration.widthOutOfRange.sug: Illustration width must be between {wMin} and {wMax} pixels.
anomaly.illustration.totalSize.suggestio: The total weight of illustrations must not exceed {maxKo} KB.
anomaly.illustration.repNotVisible.messa: Marker Rep{n} called in the text but not visible on any illustration.
anomaly.illustration.repNotVisible.sugge: Verify that the marker is actually drawn on the corresponding figure.
anomaly.illustration.repNotCalled.messag: Marker Rep{n} visible on an illustration but never called in the text.
anomaly.illustration.repNotCalled.sugges: Verify that the marker is referenced in the sheet, or remove the visual mark.
rules.script.format.name: Script format
rules.script.format.description: The document's script must start with the normalized prefix and match the regex, and exist in the reference (referenced column).
rules.granule.report.name: Element reporting
rules.granule.report.description: The document's elements are reported from the reference: 1 element (default column) outside removal-install ; 2 elements (removal + install) otherwise.
rules.texte.format_phrase.name: Sentence format
rules.texte.format_phrase.description: No leading whitespace, mandatory period, allowed sentence start (action verb / « If … then » / « Note »).
rules.texte.ordre_taches.name: Task ordering
rules.texte.ordre_taches.description: The « Task order » column must be complete, with no gap and no duplicate.
rules.texte.tache_induite.name: Induced task
rules.texte.tache_induite.description: Any task referenced in the text must appear in the « Induced task » column.
rules.texte.orthographe.name: Spelling / grammar (AI)
rules.texte.orthographe.description: Spelling, grammar and translation consistency checked by Mistral. Toggleable. Requires Mistral configured.
rules.securite.operations_standard.name: Safety operations
rules.securite.operations_standard.descr: List of standardized safety phrases (procedures, PPE, trainset immobilization).
rules.preliminaires.phrases.name: Preliminary operations — standardized phrases
rules.preliminaires.phrases.description: Expected phrases by context (de-energized, depressurized, before sensitive operation) + empty mention + accessibility.
rules.preliminaires.phrases.accessibilit: Add accessibility if equipment not accessible
rules.valeurs_num.unite_obligatoire.name: Mandatory unit
rules.valeurs_num.unite_obligatoire.desc: Any decimal numeric value must be followed by a unit (mm, N.m, V, bar, %…).
rules.valeurs_num.format_intervalle.name: Tolerance interval format
rules.valeurs_num.format_intervalle.desc: Tolerance intervals must follow the form [Lower bound ; Upper bound].
rules.serrage.marquage_ecrimetal.name: Ecrimetal marking
rules.serrage.marquage_ecrimetal.descrip: Any tightening torque must be paired with ecrimetal marking.
rules.serrage.couple_fixe.name: Fixed torque (no tolerance)
rules.serrage.couple_fixe.description: Tightening torque must be a fixed value — no « ± » or « between X and Y ».
rules.serrage.rebuter_devissee.name: Reject loose fastener
rules.serrage.rebuter_devissee.descripti: A loosened screw is rejected: never retighten. The full fastener assembly must be replaced.
rules.complementaires.contre_actions.des: Any preliminary (consignment, isolation, preparation) must have its counter-action in complementary operations.
rules.complementaires.test_equipement.de: For replacements and remove/install, an equipment test must appear in complementaries.
rules.illustrations.format_reperage.name: Figure marker format
rules.illustrations.format_reperage.desc: Every figure marker must follow the form RepXX(FigZZ). Malformed variants (extra dot, text between Rep and the parenthesis) are flagged.
rules.illustrations.dimensions.name: Illustration dimensions
rules.illustrations.dimensions.descripti: Each illustration's width must be within the configured range.
rules.illustrations.taille_totale.name: Total illustrations weight
rules.illustrations.taille_totale.descri: The cumulative weight of all illustrations in the deliverable must not exceed the configured threshold.
rules.illustrations.coherence_reperes.de: Every marker called in the text must be visible on the illustrations, and vice versa. Requires Mistral vision configured.
Compliance questions sent to Mistral vision for each illustration (PPE, safety pictograms, legibility, commercial marks…).
rules.rechanges.nom_basl.name: Spare part name identical to BASL
rules.rechanges.nom_basl.description: Each spare part name must exactly match the LCC / BASL.
rules.rechanges.doublons.name: Spare parts duplicates
rules.rechanges.doublons.description: No duplicate in the spare parts list. Optionally, one spare part per line.
rules.rechanges.recap_present.name: Recap spare part present on task
rules.rechanges.recap_present.descriptio: Every spare part listed in « Recap » must appear in the « Maintenance task ».
rules.outillages.standard.name: Standard tooling
rules.outillages.standard.description: Incremental numeric reference (1, 2, 3…) and BASL-identical designation for standard tooling.
rules.outillages.specifique.name: Specific tooling
rules.outillages.specifique.description: Reference AND designation taken from BASL for specific tooling.
rules.outillages.recap_present.name: Recap tooling present on task
rules.outillages.recap_present.descripti: Every tooling in « Recap » must appear in « Maintenance task » — except configured exceptions.
rules.infrastructure.basl.name: Infrastructure (BASL)
rules.infrastructure.basl.description: Reference and designation taken from BASL. Infrastructures are only mentioned on the « Recap ».
rules.entete_recap.champs.name: Recap header
rules.entete_recap.champs.description: Recap header fields mandatorily identical to BASL.
rules.texte.remplacer_depose_pose.name: Replacement procedure → 3.1 remove / 3.2 install
rules.texte.remplacer_depose_pose.descri: If the deliverable is a replacement procedure, the task order must contain a 3.1 row (removal) and a 3.2 row (install).
rules.preliminaires.disjoncteur.name: Circuit breaker opened → must be closed in complementaries
rules.preliminaires.disjoncteur.descript: If a preliminary operation opens a circuit breaker, a complementary operation must close it at the end of the procedure.
rules.serrage.couple_si_serrage.name: Torque required when tightening mentioned
rules.serrage.couple_si_serrage.descript: Whenever « serrage » / « serrer » terms appear, a tightening torque (N.m) must be provided.
rules.serrage.goupille_verrouillage.name: No torque on locking pin
rules.serrage.goupille_verrouillage.desc: Locking pins should not be torque-tightened. Warn the writer if a torque is mentioned near a locking pin.
rules.serrage.outillage_ay.name: Torque → tool specified (col AY)
rules.serrage.outillage_ay.description: When a tightening torque is mentioned, the measuring tool (torque wrench…) must be specified in column AY.
rules.fixer.visseries.name: Fixer / visser → fasteners (BB, BD)
rules.fixer.visseries.description: When « fixer » / « visser » terms appear, fasteners (screw, washer, nut) must be listed in columns BB and BD.
rules.fixer.meme_nombre.name: Fasteners: same item count BB ↔ BD
rules.fixer.meme_nombre.description: BB (reference) and BD (designation) fastener columns must contain the same number of items per row.
rules.verrouiller.outil_ay.name: Verrouiller / déverrouiller → tool specified (col AY)
rules.verrouiller.outil_ay.description: When locking / unlocking terms appear, the associated tool must be specified in column AY.
rules.lubrifiant.reference.name: Lubrifiant → reference provided
rules.lubrifiant.reference.description: When « lubrifiant » is mentioned in the text, its reference must be provided in the dedicated column. (Spec being finalized — column TBD.)
